title: 機械材料Ⅱ
subtitle: Engineering materials II
teachers:
SEGAWA Akio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: To design and manufacture machines and structures that exhibit superior performance, it is necessary to select materials based on an understanding of the characteristics of the elements of which they are composed. In addition, the microstructures and properties of materials change after heat treatment and processing. In this course, students learn how to modify materials by heat treatment and processing.
advice:
The outline of the class is as follows:
Fe-C phase diagram and normal microstructures
Heat treatment and microstructure of steel
Work hardening, recovery, and re-crystallization
Solid solution strengthening, precipitation strengthening, and crystal grain refinement strengthening
books:
Textbooks: Mechanical Materials(3rd edition), Tokyo Denki University Press (in Japanese)
Reference books: None
Reserved books: Introduction Structure and Properties of Metallic Materials, Taiga Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: It is strongly recommended that students take this course after reviewing and fully understanding the contents of Engineering Materials I.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the relationship between an Fe-C phase diagram and normal microstructures.
Be able to explain basic heat-treatment methods for steel.
Be able to explain basic heat-treatment methods for aluminum alloys.
Be able to explain microstructures obtained by plastic deformation, and recovery and re-crystallization

achievementLevels.ideal:
1: Explain the formation process of normal microstructures in carbon steels using an Fe-C phase diagram.
2: Propose heat-treatment conditions of steels using the Fe-C phase diagram, continuous cooling transformation (CCT) curve, and time-temperature transformation (TTT) curve.
2 and 3: Explain the relationship between mechanical properties and phase transformation and/or precipitation caused by heat treatment.
4: Explain the recovery and re-crystallization process for work-hardened materials.
achievementLevels.standard:
1: Explain the relation between carbon content in carbon steels and normal microstructures.
2 and 3: Explain basic technical terms of heat treatment, for example, quenching, tempering, annealing, normalizing, solid-solution treatment, and aging.
4: Explain the relationship between work-hardening and lattice defects.
